@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+//go:build linux
+// +build linux
+
+package prompt
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/creack/pty"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
+)
+
+func TestContextReaderTerminalPasswordRestoration(t *testing.T) {
+	master, slave, err := pty.Open()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	defer master.Close()
+	defer slave.Close()
+
+	cr := NewContextReader(slave)
+	defer cr.Close()
+	fd := int(slave.Fd())
+	echoEnabled := func() bool {
+		state, err := unix.IoctlGetTermios(fd, unix.TCGETS)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		return state.Lflag&unix.ECHO != 0
+	}
+	require.True(t, echoEnabled())
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	result := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		_, err := cr.ReadPassword(ctx)
+		result <- err
+	}()
+	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Second)
+	for echoEnabled() && time.Now().Before(deadline) {
+		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
+	}
+	require.False(t, echoEnabled(), "password read did not disable echo")
+	cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-result, context.Canceled)
+	require.True(t, echoEnabled(), "canceled password read left echo disabled")
+
+	// Complete the abandoned terminal read before starting another one.
+	_, err = master.Write([]byte("abandoned\n"))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	got, err := cr.ReadContext(context.Background())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, "abandoned", string(got))
+
+	go func() { _, _ = master.Write([]byte("secret\n")) }()
+	got, err = cr.ReadPassword(context.Background())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, "secret", string(got))
+	require.True(t, echoEnabled(), "completed password read left echo disabled")
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+//go:build aix || darwin || dragonfly || freebsd || linux || netbsd || openbsd || solaris || zos
+// +build aix darwin dragonfly freebsd linux netbsd openbsd solaris zos
+
+package prompt
+
+import (
+	"io"
+
+	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
+)
+
+func (cr *ContextReader) manualPasswordMode() bool {
+	_, ok := cr.term.(gxTerm)
+	return ok
+}
+
+// readPassword enters password mode while holding mu. Cancellation and Close
+// take the same lock, so neither can restore the terminal before echo is
+// disabled. A canceled read may still be blocked on terminal input.
+func (cr *ContextReader) readPassword() ([]byte, error, bool) {
+	if _, ok := cr.term.(gxTerm); !ok {
+		return cr.readPasswordWithTerm()
+	}
+
+	cr.mu.Lock()
+	if cr.state != readerStatePassword {
+		cr.mu.Unlock()
+		return nil, nil, false
+	}
+	oldState, err := unix.IoctlGetTermios(cr.fd, passwordIoctlReadTermios)
+	if err == nil {
+		passwordState := *oldState
+		passwordState.Lflag &^= unix.ECHO
+		passwordState.Lflag |= unix.ICANON | unix.ISIG
+		passwordState.Iflag |= unix.ICRNL
+		err = unix.IoctlSetTermios(cr.fd, passwordIoctlWriteTermios, &passwordState)
+	}
+	cr.mu.Unlock()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err, true
+	}
+
+	var password []byte
+	var b [1]byte
+	for {
+		n, err := unix.Read(cr.fd, b[:])
+		if n > 0 {
+			switch b[0] {
+			case '\b':
+				if len(password) > 0 {
+					password = password[:len(password)-1]
+				}
+			case '\n':
+				return password, nil, true
+			case '\r':
+				// Ignore CR as golang.org/x/term does on Unix.
+			default:
+				password = append(password, b[0])
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		if err == nil {
+			err = io.EOF
+		}
+		if err == io.EOF && len(password) > 0 {
+			return password, nil, true
+		}
+		return nil, err, true
+	}
+}

+//go:build aix || darwin || dragonfly || freebsd || linux || netbsd || openbsd || solaris || zos
+// +build aix darwin dragonfly freebsd linux netbsd openbsd solaris zos
+
+package prompt
+
+import (
+	"io"
+
+	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
+)
+
+func (cr *ContextReader) manualPasswordMode() bool {
+	_, ok := cr.term.(gxTerm)
+	return ok
+}
+
+// readPassword enters password mode while holding mu. Cancellation and Close
+// take the same lock, so neither can restore the terminal before echo is
+// disabled. A canceled read may still be blocked on terminal input.
+func (cr *ContextReader) readPassword() ([]byte, error, bool) {
+	if _, ok := cr.term.(gxTerm); !ok {
+		return cr.readPasswordWithTerm()
+	}
+
+	cr.mu.Lock()
+	if cr.state != readerStatePassword {
+		cr.mu.Unlock()
+		return nil, nil, false
+	}
+	oldState, err := unix.IoctlGetTermios(cr.fd, passwordIoctlReadTermios)
+	if err == nil {
+		passwordState := *oldState
+		passwordState.Lflag &^= unix.ECHO
+		passwordState.Lflag |= unix.ICANON | unix.ISIG
+		passwordState.Iflag |= unix.ICRNL
+		err = unix.IoctlSetTermios(cr.fd, passwordIoctlWriteTermios, &passwordState)
+	}
+	cr.mu.Unlock()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err, true
+	}
+
+	var password []byte
+	var b [1]byte
+	for {
+		n, err := unix.Read(cr.fd, b[:])
+		if n > 0 {
+			switch b[0] {
+			case '\b':
+				if len(password) > 0 {
+					password = password[:len(password)-1]
+				}
+			case '\n':
+				return password, nil, true
+			case '\r':
+				// Ignore CR as golang.org/x/term does on Unix.
+			default:
+				password = append(password, b[0])
+			}
+			continue
+		}
+		if err == nil {
+			err = io.EOF
+		}
+		if err == io.EOF && len(password) > 0 {
+			return password, nil, true
+		}
+		return nil, err, true
+	}
+}
